'''Jev''' was an individual who lived in the [[Markaran Plains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] along with many other villagers when [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Varmett]] massacred a village because his lover left him.
